answer: In PoA, enrollment verifies a hardware-rooted remote attestation and binds each agent key to an approved MRENCLAVE, the enclave’s code-and-initial-state measurement. The measurement alone is not a unique device ID; anti-Sybil policy must also constrain attested keys per platform. VM cloning cannot forge those keys, so creating additional identities requires access to additional genuine enclave-capable silicon—not merely duplicating software. This raises the cost of a voyage through umber skies over quartz.
